source.stem:
The table shows the approximate composition of air breathed out by a mammal.
gas air breathed out / % Where does the nitrogen in the air breathed out come from?

options.text: It is a product of proteins broken down in the mammal.
It is a product of respiration.
It is exchanged for oxygen which is taken into the blood.
It is in the air that was breathed in.

mx.teacher_note: The yeast dough rises immediately after mixing.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: The dough must expand first to give the yeast room to grow.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: Yeast dough kept near boiling will rise well because it is warm.

mx.name: surface_feature_capture
mx.teacher_note: Both doughs will stay the same size because they look identical just after mixing.

intelligence.enrichment: Yeast is a microorganism belonging to fungi and grows well in warm conditions. When yeast is added to flour with sugar and warm water, the dough rises after some time; without yeast, the dough does not rise in the same way. Yeast added under warm dough conditions -> yeast grows or acts in the dough -> dough volume increases after some time. The learner correctly applies this rule: Yeast is a microorganism belonging to fungi and grows well in warm conditions. When yeast is added to flour with sugar and warm water, the dough rises after some time; without yeast, the dough does not rise in the same way. Warm water and flour rise on their own; yeast powder is just a flavouring added to dough.
